raw_title: BMW’s iX4 SUV is a 428-mile defensive weapon against China’s EV takeover
title: BMW’s iX4 SUV is a 428-mile defensive weapon against China’s EV takeover
raw_summary: While much of the automotive world sits dumbfounded as China gobbles up all its customers, BMW continues to roll out extremely well-crafted, technologically advanced electric vehicles that impress in both drive quality and price.
